name: End to End Cyclist Priya

intro.text: Nine days from Land's End! I'm still clipped in. I can't actually get off the bike. Battle me, it'll give my legs something else to think about.

win: Beaten at the finish line. Typical.
after: The fastest End to End by bike takes under two days. They don't stop for chips. I stopped for chips every day. I regret nothing.
